learning_outcomes.text: Explore and analyse the contribution of individuals and their behaviours to organizational performance
Enhance understanding and awareness of one’s own behaviours and group dynamics in workplace contexts
Explore and analyse the nature of change within organizations and the main organizational issues
Deepen knowledge of change management and innovation in organizations

syllabus_topics: Organizational Behavior: focus on individual, group, and organizational behaviours and dynamics - within organizations (key topics include the history of organizational theory, personality, perception and motivation, team dynamics and leadership, organizational culture)

Organizational Innovation: focus on change within organizations, organizational models, and innovation management (key topics include change management, process management, project management, innovation management – with a particular focus on open innovation)
assessment_rules: Assessment will be based on a comprehensive oral exam covering the entire course. As an additional option for students with good attendance, it will also be possible to take intermediate assessments, consisting of a first written exam and a second oral exam, each on one of the two parts of the course. Both intermediate assessments must be passed.
